title: Historia paenitentiae Adae et Euae (Armenian Penitence of Adam and Eve)

details.intro:
The Historia paenitentiae Adae et Euae (Armenian Penitence of Adam and Eve) is the distinct Armenian recension of the penance narrative, published by Yovsēp‘ianc‘ from a 1404 CE manuscript copied by F. C. Conybeare.

It narrates the forty days penance of Adam in the Jordan River and Eve in the Tigris, the second deception of Eve by Satan appearing in the guise of an angel of light, and Adam's subsequent lamentation. It represents an independent translation tradition closely allied to the Latin Vita Adae et Evae.
details.provenance:
Language: Classical Armenian.
Date: 5th–7th century CE Armenian translation from a Greek Vorlage.
details.manuscripts: • Primary Manuscript: Erevan, Matenadaran MS 1521, fols. 66r–69r (copied in 1404 CE; collation by F. C. Conybeare).
